summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing that its board declared a third quarter 2026 supplemental dividend of $0.02 per share, paid from excess quarterly undistributed net investment income above the previously declared $0.36 base dividend. Both dividends are payable October 13, 2026 to holders of record September 25, 2026. No advisor or recommendation was disclosed. The filing is a routine capital-return event for the externally managed BDC; the arbitrage angle centers on the sustainability of net investment income coverage and any future supplemental declarations.
